newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 continues slide at fixing.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 continues slide at fixing.

text.p: 0900 GMT - The Czech PX50 falls at Monday's fixing.
* PX50 drops three points, 0.55 percent, to 540.4.
* On PX50, 22 shares rise, 23 down, five unchanged.
The Czech PX50 index fell again at Monday's price fixing on the Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) with major issues mixed and most of the downward pressure coming from the broader market.
Among the highly capitalised shares, CEZ lost 20 crowns, 1.9 percent, to 1,020.

But the biggest loser among shares with a weighting greater than three percent of the PX50's total capitalisation was Tabak which fell 417 crowns, 4.9 percent, to 7,928. Although, Tabak is the sixth most heavily weighted share on the PX50 it is relatively illiquid and prone to wild price swings.
Banking issues had a relatively good morning. Komercni Banka rose 34 crowns to 2,260, Ceska Sporitelna gained four crowns to 318 and Zivnostenska Banka rose 20 crowns to 2,620.
